digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow completion recovery and close gate
propositions: A ticket with large context (34K–41K chars) cannot close because bounded recovery rejects any context over 24,000 chars before executing any model calls

The recovery failure path emits a false remedy ('install the agents extra') for step-budget exhaustions that demonstrably ran the model, because recovery_failure_cause() returns None for non-CompletionRecoveryError exceptions

The criteria-vs-context bounds are mutually incoherent: _MAX_TOTAL_CRITERIA_CHARS (32,000) exceeds _MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS (24,000), allowing a valid criteria set to pass all checks then fail on context validation

Raising the context cap to 100,000 chars without compaction covers observed large tickets (9fd4: 34,282 chars; 2932: 41,595 chars) while maintaining the fail-closed cost safeguard of zero billable recovery calls on breach
The remedy selection logic must use cause-based classification instead of exception type to accurately attribute step-budget failures instead of blaming missing dependencies

An earlier compaction-based design was withdrawn because it silently deleted whole child tickets on epic closes by treating all content after the first comment heading as droppable, creating a signed-false-pass vector
